Description: Receive trigger input containing CRM Case ID.
Initialize runtime context (correlation ID config path logging scope).
Open CRM Platform UI or establish CRM API/session using robot credentials.
Perform technical prechecks (CRM Address Directory Configuration DB reachable; credentials valid).
Load runtime configuration (endpoints timeouts retry limits feature flags).
Retrieve CRM case by Case ID.
Validate case status/type is in scope (not closed/cancelled/out-of-scope).
Parse CRM payload into internal data model groups (account contact organization address payment payer servicepoints).
Validate presence of all mandatory trigger-tier fields according to schema (no semantic checks yet).
Validate basic field formats (email phone IBAN postal code dates) according to schema/regex rules.
Associate case with internal customer context (account/contact/organization/payer) in CRM.
Open Address Directory UI or establish Address Directory API/session.
Initialize iteration over all servicepoints in the payload.
For current servicepoint determine validation case A (PostalCode + Identifier) or B (PostalCode only).
Case A: Call Address Directory to validate existence of PostalCode + Identifier combination (Rule R1).
Case B: Call Address Directory to validate PostalCode exists (Rule R2) and classification is allowed (Rule R3).
Mark current servicepoint as VALID or INVALID; append to corresponding result collection.
Check if additional servicepoints remain in the list.
Derive overall validation outcome (all VALID vs. at least one INVALID).
Write configuration record into Configuration Database (validated servicepoints payment schedule/method options metadata).
Update CRM case: set final status (Completed if all VALID; Requires Manual Review if any INVALID or validation error).
Handle out-of-scope or ineligible case: log reason update CRM with non-processable status skip configuration.
Handle validation failure (missing/invalid mandatory data): log details update CRM to request manual correction.
Handle technical error during external calls: apply retry policy; if still failing mark CRM case as Technical Error.
Gracefully close or sign out of CRM Address Directory and Configuration Database sessions/applications.
Finalize logging and audit trail (outcome timestamps error codes counts); release resources.
End of process instance.
